name: PRIORE
purpose: Estimated 3-year risk of sustained kidney function decline, used to prioritise kidney reassessment in primary care.
outcome: Sustained eGFR decline of 30% or more within 3 years: the first eGFR after the current result at or below 70% of the previous 2-year mean, confirmed by a later eGFR at or below that level at least 90 days afterwards, with no intervening eGFR above it.

provenance.model_family: L2-penalised (ridge) logistic regression, scikit-learn LogisticRegression(penalty="l2", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=5000, class_weight=None); intercept not penalised
provenance.statement: Numbers copied programmatically at full precision from the frozen parameter file. No refitting, recalibration or imputation.

numeric_predictors.name: age_at_index
numeric_predictors.description: Age in whole years at the date of the current eGFR

numeric_predictors.name: baseline_egfr_mean_preindex_2y
numeric_predictors.description: Mean of the daily eGFR values used from the 730 days before the current eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2)

numeric_predictors.name: egfr_relative_change_mean_to_index_2y
numeric_predictors.description: (current eGFR - previous 2-year mean) / previous 2-year mean, as a proportion

sex.unknown_rule: Unknown or unrecorded sex is scored as U (frozen external implementation rule).

binary_predictors.name: acei_arb_1y
binary_predictors.description: ACE inhibitor or ARB use in the 365 days before the current eGFR (1 = yes, 0 = no)

binary_predictors.name: diuretic_1y
binary_predictors.description: Diuretic use in the 365 days before the current eGFR (1 = yes, 0 = no)

binary_predictors.name: polypharmacy_5plus_1y
binary_predictors.description: 5 or more different medicines in the 365 days before the current eGFR (1 = yes, 0 = no)

linear_predictor: intercept + sum(coefficient * (value - scaling_mean) / scaling_sd) over the 4 numeric predictors + sex coefficient (0 for F) + sum(coefficient * flag) over the 3 binary predictors
scaling_note: StandardScaler: scaling_sd is the POPULATION standard deviation (ddof=0) of the development values after median imputation

threshold.rule: higher priority for kidney reassessment when the unrounded probability is >= 0.05 (the study rule p >= t)

egfr_history.window: dates d with current date - 730 days <= d < current date
egfr_history.same_day_results: averaged into one daily value before the range rule is applied
egfr_history.previous_mean: arithmetic mean of the daily values used
egfr_history.source: development code: cleaning script same-day aggregation; FINAL_03 get_valid_preindex_lookback and summarize_lookback (reproduced exactly for all 33,377 development and 14,812 temporal-validation patients)

medication_definitions_frozen.window: [index_date - 365 days, index_date): days_before_index 1..365; index day excluded
medication_definitions_frozen.source: GP DuckDB clinical.medication_atc_component; executed 01b cleaning (upper-case, strip, remove non-alphanumerics); de-duplicated on (patient, index date, medication date, code); no record -> 0
medication_definitions_frozen.acei_arb_1y: any cleaned code starting C09A, C09B, C09C or C09D
medication_definitions_frozen.diuretic_1y: any cleaned code starting C03 (component-code rule; single-coded ACEi/ARB+diuretic combinations not counted - see medication sensitivities)
medication_definitions_frozen.polypharmacy_5plus_1y: >=5 distinct cleaned code strings (the non-ATC placeholder UNKNOWN counts as one code - see medication sensitivities)

verification_note: Frozen production-pipeline values. V4 has missing values and needs median imputation, which the calculator does not perform; it is listed for completeness only.
